verdict.rationale: Grok Build is a coding agent, so showing license and public-code matching references for AI-suggested code is a fair question for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence pack documents code-referencing, license attribution or public-code matching. Permissions, sandboxing, plan mode and hooks are different review-safety features and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can see license and public-code matching references for AI-suggested code
